confirmed_spec_rules_summary: Anchor modes: PR, PR_SEGMENT, DIRECT_COMMIT, USER_COMPOSITE (only PR and DIRECT_COMMIT auto-generated; 1 DIRECT_COMMIT per verified default-branch NO_MATCH_OBSERVED commit; multi-commit clustering out of MVP).
Import runs: UNKNOWN != no PR; incomplete PR association sets Import Run status='PARTIAL' (PARTIAL_SUCCESS is not official) and promotes 0 Events; default Event search returns 0.
Lifecycle statuses: CANDIDATE, CONFIRMED, REJECTED, SUPERSEDED, STALE separated from top-level visibility is_active_top_level (no arbitrary ACTIVE/EXCLUDED/DISSOLVED).
Split: Mixed-purpose PR stays 1 CANDIDATE with review flag (0 auto-split); explicit user split requires disjoint evidence scopes, yields PR_SEGMENT (or DIRECT_COMMIT), and marks parent SUPERSEDED.

Merge: Same workspace and same repository across eligible PR, PR_SEGMENT, DIRECT_COMMIT (PR+DIRECT_COMMIT allowed); checks each member Event version; preserves snapshots; marks members SUPERSEDED; rolls up member-only search hits once to USER_COMPOSITE; no auto-inheritance of member Fact/Claim.

Dissolve: Requires expected_version, reason, idempotency_key; sets Composite SUPERSEDED + composite_membership_status='REMOVED'; re-evaluates members (CANDIDATE/CONFIRMED/STALE); marks Composite FACT/CLAIM/EXPORT STALE without deletion or auto-transfer.

Event API error codes: EVENT_VERSION_CONFLICT, CROSS_WORKSPACE_MEMBER, CROSS_REPOSITORY_MEMBER, DUPLICATE_COMPOSITE_MEMBER, NESTED_COMPOSITE_NOT_ALLOWED, CANNOT_LINK_CONFLICT, MEMBER_NOT_ACTIVE, MEMBER_ALREADY_COMPOSED, PR_ASSOCIATION_INCOMPLETE. CANNOT_LINK is a relation semantic, not a catch-all wire code.
